name: AIA Singapore

scam_info.sample: SMS from AIA can be identified using the following SMS Sender ID: AIA SG/AIASG From AIA/FROMAIA AIAVitality Email from AIA can be identified using the following domain: aia.com.sg aia.com
scam_info.notes: Security Advisory hub: banner 'Beware of scammers impersonating as AIA Singapore staff or AIA Consultant', official sender IDs and email domains (official), FAQ, and 'Recent security advisories' list (~23 dated advisories, 2021-11-09 .. 2026-09-10, each 'View Advisory' link). Also lists example spam/phishing sender addresses (fake, text only): john.d@b631.com, john2@catworld.net, abuse@aia.com (spoofed), rich.c@zenzones.com - old generic examples. Sitemap lastmod 2026-09-18.

notes: official_domains (a): aia.com.sg and aia.com stated as official email domains; aia.com.sg is the serving domain. Individual advisory PDFs/pages behind 'View Advisory' not opened.
